record.label: Separate Find-Any and Find-All checks
record.statement: Appendix B describes how Comparator checks the specified theorem statements, their transitive definitions, and the axioms used by their proofs against a frozen challenge.
record.boundary: Each solution file contains `sorry` placeholders for the other task. Comparator checks the theorems named in a configuration and the dependencies of those theorems. Checking both tasks requires running both configurations.
